Issue Triage:

Title: App crashes on startup after upgrade

Description: The application crashes immediately upon startup following an upgrade.

Next Steps:
- Investigate recent changes related to startup initialization.
- Check logs for crash reports and stack traces.
- Identify if the upgrade introduced breaking changes or incompatibilities.
- Consider rolling back to the previous version if urgent fix is needed.

The team has also requested to notify the status page about this incident.
